summary: Goldgroup Mining Inc. filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, furnishing two news releases dated September 8 and 10, 2026. The principal release reports initial assay results from the first six holes of a 26,000-metre diamond drill program at the formerly producing San Francisco Gold Project in Sonora, Mexico, citing intercepts such as 23.4 metres grading 1.71 g/t gold and 16.8 metres grading 4.36 g/t gold. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are stated; the filing is an operational exploration update, not a special situation.
